Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix high-severity CSS/UX bugs: remove overlay conflicts and image lightbox issues

- Remove full-card overlay in PostCard to prevent accidental navigation clicks
- Add link detection for image lightbox to avoid conflicts with navigation
- Convert PostCard tags from spans to clickable category links
- Fix navigation link from /category/travel to /category/domestic-travel
- Add deployment verification checklist for testing on production

These fixes resolve issues where users would accidentally trigger navigation
when clicking on empty card areas or experience inconsistent image behavior.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix critical UX bug: Lightbox overlay intercepting all clicks on article pages

Problem:
- Lightbox modal had conflicting CSS classes \(hidden + flex\) causing display issues
- The invisible overlay remained active and intercepted clicks on whitespace
- Users clicking article content areas would trigger unexpected navigation

Root Cause:
- In Layout.astro:447, lightbox used both ''hidden'' and ''flex'' classes simultaneously
- CSS cascade caused ''flex'' to override ''hidden'', leaving an invisible clickable layer
- z-index: 60 ensured the overlay stayed above all content

Solution:
- Removed conflicting CSS classes from lightbox initialization
- Changed to inline style: display: none for reliable hiding
- Updated show/hide logic to use display: flex/none instead of CSS classes
- Prevents overlay from intercepting clicks when lightbox is closed

Files Modified:
- src/layouts/Layout.astro: Fixed lightbox display logic \(lines 447-448, 466, 520\)
- diagnose_click_issue.js: Added diagnostic tool for future debugging

This resolves the TODO.md issue: "UI Bug: Clickable Whitespace causing unintended navigation"

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
